acip: MA GRUB NA, GSER BUM CHOS CAN, BUM PA DANG GCIG TU GYUR PA'I BUM PA YIN PAR THAL, BUM PA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
english: I disagree that it is not the case that—if something is a coffee cup—then it must be a coffee cup which is one and the same as a coffee cup. If you do disagree, then let's consider a porcelain coffee cup.  Are you saying that it has to be a coffee cup which is one and the same as a coffee cup? Why do you say that? Because it's a coffee cup!
wylie: ma grub na, gser bum chos can, bum pa dang gcig tu gyur pa'i bum pa yin par thal, bum pa yin pa'i phyir
